# xcelsior_volume_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a volume to a running instance. To mount a volume from the start, use `volume_ids` on `xcelsior_instance` instead. Every argument forces a new attachment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xcelsior_volume_attachment" "scratch" {
  volume_id   = xcelsior_volume.scratch.id
  instance_id = xcelsior_instance.train.id
  mount_path  = "/mnt/scratch"
  mode        = "rw"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String)
- `volume_id` (String)

### Optional

- `mode` (String) `rw` (the default) or `ro`.
- `mount_path` (String) `/workspace` (the default), `/data`, or `/mnt/<name>`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<volume_id>/<instance_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import xcelsior_volume_attachment.scratch <volume-id>/<instance-id>
```
